lines.text: David sang this song when the LORD delivered him from his enemies and Saul, calling the LORD his rock and fortress.
The cords of death entangled David, and from His temple the LORD heard his cry for help.
The earth shook because the LORD burned with anger, and He thundered from heaven with rain and rivers of water.
The LORD reached down, drew David out of deep waters, and rescued him because He delighted in him.
The LORD makes David's feet like a deer's and trains his hands so his arms can break iron chains.
